label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is TP. The variable 'corr' is assigned the value of request.getHeader('X-Correlation-Id') (line 19), which represents untrusted user-supplied input. This value is concatenated into the response body via response.getWriter().println('id=' + corr) (line 22) without any HTML encoding or sanitization. An attacker can inject script payloads into the header, leading to reflected XSS.

evidence.note: Header value 'corr' flows directly to response.getWriter() without encoding.
